responsibility: Implements rewindable sequential-file channels on top of FIO and the generic RTgen/RTfio device stack. It allocates a device id, builds DeviceTable hooks for text/raw operations, opens files in read, write, or append mode, provides reset procedures that reposition to the beginning or end and update channel flags, supports reread/rewrite mode changes through FIO seek operations, and closes channels through IOLink while translating file and errno conditions into ISO device behavior.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the SeqFile pair: it builds the actual sequential-file device integration over FIO/RTgen/IOLink and executes Open*/Reread/Rewrite/Close, whereas SeqFile.def only declares those operations.
